seo.title: Trust and security at Avesta Tech
seo.description: How Avesta handles your code, our signing keys and your data. Local-first scanning, verifiable signatures and a public disclosure policy.

sections.heading: A compliance tool has to be trustworthy itself.
sections.sub: We ask you to trust our evidence, so we show you ours. Here is how we handle your code, our keys and your data.

rows.heading: Your code stays with you.
rows.body: Avesta Proof runs in your CI or on your own machine, including air-gapped machines. We do not need a copy of your source code. Only signed results leave your environment, and only if you send them.

rows.heading: Evidence anyone can check.
rows.body: Every report has a SHA-256 fingerprint and an Ed25519 signature. Scans are linked in a hash chain. Verification works offline with the public key, so your auditor does not have to trust us.

rows.heading: Keys.
rows.body: Private signing keys are written with owner-only file permissions (0600). For production, we recommend keeping them in a KMS or HSM; built-in support for that is on our roadmap.

rows.heading: We scan ourselves.
rows.body: Avesta Proof runs on its own code in CI. We publish our own SBOM and a SECURITY.md. Our own trust statement: [LINK_OWN_TRUST_STATEMENT].

rows.heading: Our roadmap to stronger proof.
rows.body: Signed releases · an independent pen test of Avesta Proof · KMS/HSM key support. Status of each: [TRUST_ROADMAP_STATUS]. We list these as plans until they are done.

rows.heading: Your data.
rows.body: We process only what we need to deliver the service. Client data and findings are kept for [RETENTION_PERIOD] and deleted on request. We sign a data processing agreement on request. Full details in the [Privacy policy](/legal/privacy).

rows.heading: Report a vulnerability.
rows.body: Found a security issue in Avesta Proof or this website? Email [SECURITY_EMAIL]. We reply within [RESPONSE_DAYS] working days and credit researchers who want credit. See our [disclosure policy](/legal/disclosure) and [/.well-known/security.txt](/.well-known/security.txt).

rows.heading: What we will not claim.
rows.body: Avesta produces audit-ready evidence. We do not certify products, and we do not give legal advice. Certification is issued by accredited bodies; legal questions belong with your counsel.
